resolvedDeviations.summary: First fire attempt exposed a bearer-prefix bug in canary-runner.ts: KJ_ADMISSION_BEARER was sent raw instead of 'Bearer <token>', rejected 401 by the admission door.
resolvedDeviations.impact: schedule_fires row created PLANNED, admission never reached, 0 tasks admitted

resolvedDeviations.summary: Fixed by PR #19 (fix/gate3-canary-admission-bearer-prefix), merged to main as b210c1b8e78dcea86b3a9080c6ebcf17ee16f527.

Re-arming v2 after the failed attempt required a direct call to the reviewed PgScheduleStore.setState (same fail-closed identity check as disable-canary), because enable-canary's ALREADY_PRODUCTION guard correctly refuses to re-enable a version that already has enabled_for_production=true.

Replay proof initially failed NOT_FIRABLE due to a temporal-consistency mismatch: --now was the historical window bound, which was before the re-arm's real updated_at. Corrected by using current time for --now while preserving the same fire-window identity.

nextPhase.description: First unattended production fire via the durable Restate-driven ScheduleTimerDriver wake path (ScheduleDriver Virtual Object), deliberately deferred by Gate 3 (GAP F). Requires its own separate change-window authorisation.
